k07-laupen.beschreibung: Illustration of the Battle of Laupen (1339) between Swiss forces and an army of the Dukes of Savoy. It still shows the old german red flag with a white cross upon it. The confederate forces are on the right. The Bernese victory at the Battle of Laupen helped bring Bern into the Swiss Confederation.
